name: Density follows the task
rule: Tighten rows and spacing where people scan and compare data; give decisions and forms more room.

leaders.note: Offers a range of row heights. Tighter rows pack in more data, looser ones suit emphasis and multi-line content. Hover and zebra stripes aid scanning.
Rows suit scannable text, so entries stay short. Grouped styles add space between sets, and alternating row colors help track values across wide tables.
